basis: Western mundane astrology (kb western-astro: configurations by planet nature; the input supplies the referendum-day configuration and the available UK national charts 1066/1801/1922, but no computed transits are attached, so the call rests on the named configuration). Named configuration: on referendum day Uranus and Ceres are conjunct at 23 degrees Aries. Uranus is the disruption/rupture significator — sudden breaks, separations, rebellion against the existing order; Aries is cardinal fire, the sign of unilateral initiative and severance. A Uranus conjunction perfecting on the very day of the vote, in the sign of breaking away, reads for rupture of the status quo arrangement rather than its continuation — in referendum terms, a vote to leave the existing union. Ceres (nourishment, membership, what feeds the body politic) conjoined with the planet of severance points to the membership bond itself being cut. The February polling lead for 'Stay' is a non-astrological input and is outweighed, in this method, by a day-exact disruption configuration; the large 'not sure' bloc is precisely the population a Uranian shock configuration moves late. Single-point question; timing is the referendum date, 23 June 2016.
prediction_text: Yes — Britain will vote to leave the European Union in the referendum of 23 June 2016. The Uranus-Ceres conjunction at 23 degrees Aries on referendum day is a rupture configuration: the vote breaks the existing membership bond despite the 'Stay' lead in the February polls, with late-deciding and previously unsure voters swinging the result to Leave. The outcome is a Leave victory, and it will come as a shock to the polling-based expectation.
